name: Frost
fantasy: Freeze routes, preserve value, slow threats, and turn cold into crystal-clear control.
beginner: Freeze things so they cannot cause trouble.

name: Lightning
fantasy: Charge tiles, chain bursts, build storm engines, and turn setup into explosive turns.
beginner: Charge things, then make the charge pop.

name: Life
fantasy: Heal, grow creatures, spread gardens, make tokens, and win by building a thriving realm.

name: Fire
fantasy: Burn terrain, pressure Hearts, hatch dragons, and turn destruction into new opportunities.

name: Water
fantasy: Wet the board, redirect movement, flow around defenses, and combine weather into strange terrain.
beginner: Move things around and make everything wet.

name: Earth
fantasy: Fortify tiles, build landmarks, make sturdy creatures, and score through an unmovable realm.
beginner: Build strong places that are hard to move.

name: Wind
fantasy: Move creatures, dodge blockers, create floating terrain, and win through clever positioning.
beginner: Move your creatures where they need to be.

name: Death
fantasy: Use friendly ghosts, sacrifice, recursion, haunted terrain, and value that refuses to stay gone.
beginner: Your spooky friends keep coming back.
